body.p: by the orchestrator. clang-tidy's clang-analyzer-security.insecureAPI.DeprecatedOrUnsafeBufferHandling rejects memcpy, memset and snprintf in favour of the C11 Annex K _s functions, which glibc, macOS and WASI do not provide. Packets wrote byte loops instead. The check is switched off in .clang-tidy; memcpy, memmove and memset are allowed when the byte count comes from checked size arithmetic. Printing functions stay banned outside the CLI platform layer (, ). Existing byte loops may stay; new code uses memcpy.
